svg.title: ClickHouse 100% Spot + NVMe Instance-Store Cache + CAS Benchmark & Churn Telemetry
svg.desc: Four-panel engineering benchmark report on AWS Graviton: (1) 81.86 TB/day 10-minute burst row convergence from 53,443,013 to 334,739,767 exact rows across 6 Spot replicas with 49s staging drain; (2) 100-minute AWS Spot churn swimlanes across 15 Spot EC2 launches and 6 AWS Spot interruptions; (3) role-scoped NVMe reader cache (1.8 GB/s vs 131 MB/s gp3) and mixed-instance Spot architecture; (4) measured 46% cluster cost reduction ($3.26/hr On-Demand to $1.75/hr Spot+NVMe) and production hybrid recommendations.
svg.text: ClickHouse 100% Spot + NVMe Cache + CAS Stress Test: 81.86 TB/day Burst Under Live Churn
Single-AZ AWS Graviton · Antalya 26.8 + chinit v0.2.8 · 53,443,013 + 281,296,754 = 334,739,767 exact rows (0 loss)
1. 81.86 TB/day Burst — Row Convergence & Mid-Run Churn (27m Window)
2,925 files · 571.3 GB NDJSON in 10m 03s (466.8k rec/s) · 744.5 GiB uncomp → 47.8 GiB hot (15.57× ZSTD)
New NVMe Spot R0 backfill → 0s lag in 79s
Total S3 API spend across entire 81.86 TB/day burst + post-drain: $0.0662 (peak $0.357/hr · 0 Code 241 OOMs)
2. 100-Min AWS Spot Churn & Recovery Timeline (15 Spot Launches)
6 AWS Spot reclaims (1 Writer, 5 NVMe Readers in Single-AZ) + 3 idle step-downs + 3 CPU scale-outs
02:00Z wake → S3 tar backup OK → self-stop
AWS Spot Reclaim (2-min ITN → chinit <0.6s drain)
Finding: m8gd.xlarge in single-AZ reclaimed 5× in 60m → enable Multi-AZ + wider *gd pool in prod
3. Role-Scoped NVMe Cache Architecture & Direct-IO Benchmark
reader_cache_on_nvme_instance_store = true · 1.8 GB/s NVMe vs 131 MB/s baseline gp3 cache (13.7×)
• Lazy cold cache only (0B on relink!)
Hot vs. Cold NVMe Cache Boundary
• NVMe cas_cache warms lazily on SELECT
• Set cold TTL 7d → 1–2d to activate early
us-west-2 live pricing · includes EC2, gp3 EBS (500 MB/s), 2 NLBs, Keepers & S3 API
A. All On-Demand (3× m8g.4xl + 2× m8g.xl + gp3 cache)
B. 100% Spot Writers + NVMe Spot Readers (Measured Live)
C. Prod Hybrid (1 OD Base W + 1 OD Base R + Multi-AZ Spot)
Key Stability Findings & Next Levers for 9.8/10 Production Spot:
1. Zero Data Loss Proven: Survived 6 Spot reclaims + mid-burst 3→2→4 scaling with 0 lost rows.
2. Multi-AZ Unlocks *gd Spot: Enable multi_az_config + add r8gd/r7gd/c7gd to stop single-AZ pinches.
3. Writer Hot NVMe Next: Backfill pushed writer gp3 to 45–85% %iowait; *gd NVMe hot removes it.
4. Anchor Quorum Floor: Keep writer_spot_on_demand_base_capacity = 1 (dev) / 2 (prod) + min_readers = 2.
Colored bar segment = EC2 compute (Writers + Readers); grey tail = fixed Keepers + EBS + NLBs + S3 API.
